title: The Awesome view from the ridge
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：awesome　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 awesome 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 the athlete wrote of ① an awesome view from the ridge in the programme, and everybody in the stadium said at once that it was ② more awesome than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the athlete, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the awesome ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most awesome view from the ridge anybody in the stadium had ever seen, or so the programme for September 1945 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too awesome to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the trainer who had come to help; the awesome ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an awesome feat of memory, and said that no trainer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as awesome as the feat of memory they had once had in the old stadium. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was awesome or not, and he said so.

By 1958 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something awesome, and nothing besides. The trainer from the next stadium called the whole plan ⑧ quite awesome; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the awesome ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1961, year after year, she wrote of another awesome view from the ridge in the same programme, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more awesome than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most awesome feat of memory in the whole stadium, she said in 1963, was the one she could never quite name; the awesome ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 令人惊叹（前置定语 an awesome view from the ridge：1951 年运动员在秩序册里记下的那件令人惊叹的景致）
B. adj. 令人惊叹／极好（比较级 more awesome than：文中两处，一处比山脊上的景致，一处比预想）
C. adj. 令人惊叹／极好（最高级 the most awesome：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 令人惊叹（表语 too awesome to do：母亲觉得它太令人惊叹，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 极好（前置定语 an awesome feat of memory：叔叔把整件事称作一桩极好的壮举）
F. adj. 极好（同级比较 as awesome as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩记忆的壮举相比）
G. adj. 极好（后置定语 something awesome：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 极好（受程度副词修饰 quite awesome：那位陪练的评价）

items.q: an awesome view from the ridge
the most awesome view from the ridge anybody

answers.why: awesome 意为“令人惊叹”，1951 年运动员在秩序册里记下的是“一件令人惊叹的景致”，此处作前置定语 an awesome view from the ridge。
awesome 意为“令人惊叹”，此处用比较级 more awesome than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
awesome 意为“令人惊叹”，秩序册上 九月 那行字说它是体育场里最令人惊叹的一件，故用最高级 the most awesome view from the ridge。
awesome 意为“令人惊叹”，母亲认为这件东西“太令人惊叹了，谁也用不上”，too awesome to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
awesome 意为“极好”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩极好的壮举”，此处作前置定语 an awesome feat of memory。
awesome 意为“极好”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩记忆的壮举一样极好”，同级比较用 as awesome as。
awesome 意为“极好”，秩序册上那半行字要的是“极好的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something awesome。
awesome 意为“极好”，邻体育场来的那位陪练认为这套计划“相当极好”，quite 修饰原级 awesome。
awesome 意为“极好”，1961 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要极好”，故用比较级 more awesome than。
awesome 意为“极好”，母亲 1963 年说的是“整个体育场里最极好的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most awesome feat of memory。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1951 年，运动员在秩序册里记下了一件令人惊叹的景致。（an awesome view from the ridge）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更令人惊叹。（more awesome than …）
母亲觉得它太令人惊叹，谁也用不上。（too awesome to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩极好的壮举。（an awesome feat of memory）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩记忆的壮举一样极好。（as awesome as …）
到了 1958 年，秩序册上只剩半行字：要的是一件极好的东西。（something awesome）
answers: In 1951 the athlete wrote of an awesome view from the ridge in the programme.
Everybody said it was more awesome than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too awesome to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an awesome feat of memory.
He said nobody would call it as awesome as the feat of memory they had once had.
By 1958 the programme asked for nothing but something awesome.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 awesome 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1951 the athlete wrote of an awesome view from the ridge in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most awesome view from the ridge in the stadium, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too awesome to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an awesome feat of memory, and nobody argued with him.
The trainer from the next stadium called the plan quite awesome, and everybody laughed.
The awesome ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
